PM2.policy_source: BH26 demo population evidence QC policy
PM2.threshold_source: BH26 provisional PM2 rarity threshold (PLACEHOLDER - not a reviewed clinical value). ACMG/AMP 2015 says "absent from controls (or at extremely low frequency if recessive)"; a literal 0 does not work at gnomAD scale, where a real rare variant almost always shows a few alleles. Kept below BS1.default_max_credible_af so that PM2 and BS1 are not exact complements.

BA1.policy_source: BH26 demo population evidence QC policy
BA1.threshold_source: ACMG/AMP 2015 general BA1 figure: >5% point-estimate MAF. A VCEP specification replaces both the number and, where it says so, the statistic - e.g. the ClinGen Inherited Cardiomyopathy VCEP uses 0.1%, and ClinGen SVI recommends a filtering allele frequency

BS1.policy_source: BH26 demo population evidence QC policy
BS1.default_source: BH26 provisional default BS1 threshold for rare Mendelian disease (PLACEHOLDER - not a reviewed clinical value; a real threshold is per-disease, e.g. the ClinGen Inherited Cardiomyopathy VCEP applies 0.0002 for MYH7)

hotspot.policy_source: BH26 demo PM1 hotspot proxy policy (fastVEP-style ClinVar missense density); not a ClinGen VCEP specification

revel-pejaver-2022.source: Pejaver et al. 2022, Am J Hum Genet 109:2163-2177 (ClinGen SVI PP3/BP4 calibration)

spliceai-svi-2023.source: Walker et al. 2023, Am J Hum Genet 110:1046-1067 (ClinGen SVI Splicing Subgroup)
spliceai-svi-2023.scope_note: Applies outside the donor/acceptor +/-1,2 dinucleotides, where PVS1 is used instead

unknown_version_policy.justification: Ensembl REST does not expose the SpliceAI model version. Use the score with predictor_version=UNKNOWN, retaining Ensembl source_version and retrieved_at for audit; do not represent it as SpliceAI-1.3.
